title: Align M6 Skill authorization with runtime execution capability
goal: Make M6 authorize the effective Skill execution capability set consistently with SkillRuntime, including the mandatory execute capability.
context: M6SkillExecutionAdapter currently reports manifest.requiredCapabilities to M6 but SkillRuntime evaluates that set union execute. Its exact-equality policy then rejects valid read-only manifests after M6 has approved them.
forbidden_changes: Do not weaken SkillRuntime's mandatory execute capability check.
Do not grant capabilities beyond manifest requirements plus execute.
Do not modify ModuleRuntime approval behavior, UI, or provider/GGUF code.
acceptance_criteria: The adapter validates the same effective capability set before execution.
A read-only Skill manifest executes and verifies through M6 when policy explicitly allows the effective set.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If the regression fails, inspect the effective capability set at proposal and SkillRuntime boundaries; preserve the mandatory execute check and exact authorization matching.
